note: Initial reporting shows microcephaly was documented across all 11 individuals carrying biallelic, de novo, or heterozygous NAV3 variants.

evidence.text: In a study describing 11 individuals from seven families carrying biallelic, de novo, and heterozygous NAV3 variants, microcephaly was noted in all affected individuals.

source.title: Variants of NAV3, a neuronal morphogenesis protein, cause intellectual disability, developmental delay, and microcephaly
source.quote: We report eleven individuals from seven families harboring predicted pathogenic biallelic, de novo, and heterozygous variants in the NAV3 gene, which encodes the microtubule positive tip protein neuron navigator 3 (NAV3). All affected individuals have intellectual disability (ID), microcephaly, skeletal deformities, ocular anomalies, and behavioral issues.
